dedupe_keys.name: list and map of portuguese large dams cnpgb

description: The Portuguese National Committee on Large Dams (CNPGB), the national committee of ICOLD hosted by the Portuguese Environment Agency (APA), publishes a list and a map of the large dams of Portugal. Each list entry gives the dam name, district, municipality, locality, river basin, watercourse and often the promoter, such as the former irrigation institute IHERA or water institute INAG, with a link to its location on a map, and the map view can be filtered by dam name and by river basin from Âncora and Arade to Minho and Mira. On 26 September 2026 the list ran to nine pages, the last with 11 entries, which suggests about 170 dams; this count is inferred from the page layout and was not confirmed. The site is free to browse, no licence is stated and no download or API was seen, so reuse terms must be asked of APA. Caveats: the list gives location and ownership context only, without height, reservoir volume, dam type or hazard class, some map links point to missing pages, and entries use promoters that no longer exist under those names. Simulation uses: an inventory of dams for dam-break and flood exposure studies, linking reservoirs to irrigation and water supply systems by river basin, and emergency planning downstream of dams. Related record: the ICOLD World Register of Dams (data-icold-world-register-of-dams) holds technical attributes for large dams worldwide, including Portugal.
